verdict.rationale: Manufact is a managed cloud platform for deploying, testing, and monitoring MCP servers, so self-hosting it is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence, however, only shows the platform as a hosted service ('Manufact Cloud', run.mcp-use.com URLs). Running your own MCP server locally or connecting a server hosted elsewhere covers the user's server, not self-hosting Manufact itself, and nothing documents a self-hosted deployment of the platform.
